instruction: Follow up with Dana about the proposal if she hasn't replied.
final_text:
I didn't send Dana a follow-up because she already replied. Yesterday (Mon 28 Sep) she wrote back on the "Northwind proposal" thread: *"we're reviewing it with our CFO this week and will come back to you by Friday."*

Instead, I set a reminder for **Monday 5 Oct**. If nobody has replied in that thread by then, it will bring the thread back to your inbox so you can follow up. It won't send anything.

Her reply is still marked unread in your inbox. If you'd like to thank her now, I can write a short reply.
